fusions.name: Cold Sounding Weight
fusions.desc: Drops a cold, sinking weight on the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sinking Hull
fusions.desc: Drops your full weight, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving each [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending Keel
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Grey Hull
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.3 health a second, permanently.
